side.line: Along the coach roads I did ride
stanza: Along the coach roads I did ride
With sword and pistol by my side
And many a young maid lost her baubles to my trade
And many a soldier shed his life blood on my blade
They finally hung me in the spring of '25

partner.line: With sword and pistol by my side

ride.line: Park on a back road along the highway side
stanza: At night, my daddy'd take me and we'd ride
Through the streets of a town so silent and still
Park on a back road along the highway side
Look up at that mansion on the hill
